newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 16.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 16.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Normandy Mining Ltd and Queensland Metals Corp said in a joint announcement that they would develop the QMC magnesium metals project (Magmetal), with each group holding 50 percent of the A$700 million project. Also Normandy Mining Ltd said on Thursday its gold production for the December quarter was up 9.1 percent from the September quarter at 378,117 ounces, at a total cash cost of A$337 an ounce, down from A$360.
Office supplies group Corporate Express Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it planned a one-for-five non-renounceable rights issue at 85 cents a share to raise just over A$13 million.
Amway Asia Pacific said early on Thursday that it had raised its quarterly payout to 22 US cents from 18 US cents.

United International Holdings Inc said its subsidiary UIH Asia/Pacific Communications Inc had postponed its proposed US$100 million initial public offering of class A common stock because of poor market conditions. UIH said UAP had also postponed a planned offering of US$150 million of new senior discount notes by UIH Asia/Pacific Inc, a subsidiary of UAP.
Pub owner Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd said it recommended shareholders accept the revised A$2.65 per share offer from Foster's Brewing Group Ltd in the absence of a higher offer.
